  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
sl AS (
  SELECT o.dd AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key

  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

  SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')

  round(sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt END),2) cc,

WITH o AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
sl AS (
  SELECT o.dd AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS amt, 0 AS isret
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 1
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, isret,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt END),2) cc,
  round(sum(amt),2) web,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt END)/sum(amt),2) shr
FROM sl JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=sl.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY ROLLUP(1,2,3) HAVING d.fiscal_year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2,3

FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key

WITH web_orders AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_net AS (
  SELECT o.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN web_orders o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN web_orders o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN w.net_sales END) / SUM(w.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_net w
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
